sentence: This project studies how deep learning models can measure how well the right side of the heart works and how it affects heart risk.
This project studies which genes control biofilm formation by Candida albicans infections on central venous catheters, using animal models.
This project tries to find out how protein synthesis affects thinking problems in people with Down syndrome as they age.
This project tries to find out why cancer stops responding to immunotherapies such as antibodies and T cells in neuroblastoma.
This project studies how a virus stays quiet in kidney cells and then switches to a high level of infection.
This project studies how three DNA tumor viruses cause human cancer and change cell growth, signaling pathways and immune evasion.
This project uses real-world evidence to study the risks and benefits of raising, keeping or lowering blood pressure treatment in older adults.
This project studies how a part of the rat brain represents value so that decision making stays flexible.
This project studies which features of the fungus and of nose and sinus tissue allow invasive fungal infection in vulnerable patients.
This project tries to find out how a class of RNA molecules affects scar formation in heart tissue.
This project studies how a protein controls bone density by acting in bone-building and bone-breaking cells, using a mouse model.
This project tries to find out whether an allergy antibody to a sugar molecule directly promotes plaque buildup in arteries of mice and humans.
This project studies the genomes of people with recurrent pregnancy loss to find genetic predictors of it.
This project studies whether brain imaging can guide blood thinner treatment in stroke survivors who also have atrial fibrillation.
This project uses quantitative metabolism techniques to study how cells make the one-carbon units needed for methylation of chromatin.
This project studies how chromosomes change over evolution in Drosophila and how the Y chromosome breaks down quickly in a beetle.
This project studies how a protein controls inflammation in acute lung injury, aiming to find ways to reduce lung injury.
This project builds an imaging system that makes detailed 3D maps of how much oxygen is in different parts of living tissue.
This project studies how plant cells repair their plasma membrane, focusing on proteins involved in calcium signaling, vesicle trafficking and membrane fusion.
